prs.location:
Occu Owenmore is the perfect place to call home. 

Just minutes from Raheny Village, where you’ll find cafés, shops, and friendly local businesses. St. Anne’s Park, Bull Island, and a whole coastline of walking trails and fresh sea air are all within easy reach

description:
Spacious and versatile two bedroom apartments, ideal for anyone who wants a little more room to spread out.

Features:
Modern, Stylish fully furnished apartment
Private balcony or terrace
Integrated kitchen appliances
Heat recovery ventilation system
Ensuite bathrooms (in select units)
High energy efficiency 
Ample storage throughout
